title: Asiad: Gilas Women book quarterfinals spot, dominate Hong Kong
summary: Gilas Pilipinas Women advanced to the quarterfinals after dominating Hong Kong, 90-73, in the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games on Sunday at the Aichi International Arena.
